title: Petra, Jordan | Civilisations - BBC
speaker: BBC
zh: 【BBC】約旦佩特拉 |文明 - BBC（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: There may be enemies at the gates there may be enemies within the walls and
cues.en: There may be enemies at the gates there may be enemies within the walls and
cues.zh: 門口可能有敵人，牆內也可能有敵人

cues.text: Sometimes the very landscape and climate in which a culture grows must be conquered
cues.en: Sometimes the very landscape and climate in which a culture grows must be conquered
cues.zh: 有時，文化生長的景觀和氣候必須被征服

cues.text: It may be too rocky too arid But here canyons and gullies became the streets and thoroughfares
cues.en: It may be too rocky too arid But here canyons and gullies became the streets and thoroughfares
cues.zh: 也許這裡岩石太多太乾旱但這裡的峽谷和溝壑變成了街道和大道

cues.text: for one of the most spectacular civilizations in all of human history
cues.en: for one of the most spectacular civilizations in all of human history
cues.zh: 人類歷史上最壯觀的文明之一

cues.text: This is Petra where the sheer Improbability of its location was also the secret of its
cues.en: This is Petra where the sheer Improbability of its location was also the secret of its
cues.zh: 這就是佩特拉，其位置的絕對不可能也是其秘密的所在

cues.text: spectacular flourishing The reason why this tomb Endured and survived armies and earthquakes is that the Nabataeans who built it cut it into
cues.en: spectacular flourishing The reason why this tomb Endured and survived armies and earthquakes is that the Nabataeans who built it cut it into
cues.zh: 這座墳墓之所以能經受住軍隊和地震的考驗並倖存下來，是因為建造它的納巴泰人將其切割成

cues.text: the sandstone surface of the mountain rather than build some freestanding marble monument
cues.en: the sandstone surface of the mountain rather than build some freestanding marble monument
cues.zh: 山的砂岩表面而不是建造一些獨立的大理石紀念碑

cues.text: the mountains shook with earthquakes, but these buildings stood intact
cues.en: the mountains shook with earthquakes, but these buildings stood intact
cues.zh: 山體因地震而搖晃，但這些建築物完好無損

cues.text: The Nabataeans Engineered systems to trap the rains which came in winter and their desert
cues.en: The Nabataeans Engineered systems to trap the rains which came in winter and their desert
cues.zh: 納巴泰人設計了一個系統來收集冬季和沙漠中的雨水

cues.text: Hydraulics made this place not so much rose red as bright green
cues.en: Hydraulics made this place not so much rose red as bright green
cues.zh: 水力使這個地方不再是玫瑰紅色，而是亮綠色

cues.text: a garden city of fountains swimming pools groves and orchards
cues.en: a garden city of fountains swimming pools groves and orchards
cues.zh: 噴泉、游泳池、樹林和果園的花園城市

cues.text: And the water which made all that possible also made it possible to feed a city of
cues.en: And the water which made all that possible also made it possible to feed a city of
cues.zh: 使這一切成為可能的水也使養活一座城市成為可能

cues.text: 30,000 people many of whom were immigrants from all over the region there were Egyptians and Syrians and Judeans and Greeks and Romans
cues.en: 30,000 people many of whom were immigrants from all over the region there were Egyptians and Syrians and Judeans and Greeks and Romans
cues.zh: 30,000 人，其中許多是來自該地區各地的移民，其中有埃及人、敘利亞人、猶太人、希臘人和羅馬人

cues.text: and they were all Coming to Petra to enjoy what the Persians called a parrot daisa a pleasure resource a little bit of?
cues.en: and they were all Coming to Petra to enjoy what the Persians called a parrot daisa a pleasure resource a little bit of?
cues.zh: 他們都是來佩特拉享受波斯人所說的鸚鵡黛薩的快樂資源嗎？

cues.text: Heaven on earth And they all brought a flourish of their own cultural styles with them
cues.en: Heaven on earth And they all brought a flourish of their own cultural styles with them
cues.zh: 人間天堂他們都帶來了自己文化風格的繁榮

cues.text: Most of the art discovered here has been taken to museums, but what survives tells the story of a cosmopolitan playground
cues.en: Most of the art discovered here has been taken to museums, but what survives tells the story of a cosmopolitan playground
cues.zh: 這裡發現的大部分藝術品都被帶到了博物館，但倖存下來的藝術品講述了一個國際化遊樂場的故事

cues.text: There are curious abstract representations of a Nabataean goddess
cues.en: There are curious abstract representations of a Nabataean goddess
cues.zh: 有納巴泰女神的奇怪抽象表現

cues.text: Carved heads from the wine-soaked Hellenistic count of Dionysus
cues.en: Carved heads from the wine-soaked Hellenistic count of Dionysus
cues.zh: 希臘化時期酒神狄俄尼索斯伯爵的頭像雕刻

cues.text: Recent excavations have brought to light ritzy villas carved into the living rock
cues.en: Recent excavations have brought to light ritzy villas carved into the living rock
cues.zh: 最近的挖掘工作揭示了雕刻在活巖上的豪華別墅

cues.text: Inside them here's to happiness murals from that same Dionysian cult
cues.en: Inside them here's to happiness murals from that same Dionysian cult
cues.zh: 裡面有來自同一個酒神崇拜的幸福壁畫

cues.text: cherubs vine leaves the inevitable bunches of grapes and
cues.en: cherubs vine leaves the inevitable bunches of grapes and
cues.zh: 小天使藤留下不可避免的葡萄串和

cues.text: From the later years of Petra's life Byzantine mosaics found beneath the sand and rubble of a ruined church
cues.en: From the later years of Petra's life Byzantine mosaics found beneath the sand and rubble of a ruined church
cues.zh: 佩特拉晚年在一座廢棄教堂的沙子和瓦礫下發現的拜占庭馬賽克

cues.text: Petra had its day or rather at centuries, and then it ended
cues.en: Petra had its day or rather at centuries, and then it ended
cues.zh: 佩特拉有過它的一天，或者更確切地說，有幾個世紀，然後它就結束了

cues.text: Not because of conquest, but because new trade routes simply made Petra
cues.en: Not because of conquest, but because new trade routes simply made Petra
cues.zh: 不是因為征服，而是因為新的貿易路線讓佩特拉

cues.text: commercially irrelevant And without that commercial lifeblood there was no longer any reason to struggle against the desert
cues.en: commercially irrelevant And without that commercial lifeblood there was no longer any reason to struggle against the desert
cues.zh: 與商業無關 如果沒有商業命脈，就不再有任何理由與沙漠作鬥爭

cues.text: The people left the systems for capturing water fell into disrepair and the desert
cues.en: The people left the systems for capturing water fell into disrepair and the desert
cues.zh: 人們留下的取水系統年久失修，沙漠化

cues.text: reclaimed the city
cues.en: reclaimed the city
cues.zh: 收復城市
